title: Missing values sort to the bottom ascending and to the top descending; a Margin % em dash counts as missing
custom_preconds: 1. At least one customer row shows an em dash (—) in Margin % (Subtotal zero or below — seed a zero-subtotal case if possible) alongside rows with real Margin % values.
custom_steps:
1. Sort by Margin % ascending and note where the em-dash row lands.
2. Sort by Margin % descending and note it again.
custom_expected:
1. Ascending: the em-dash (missing) row sorts to the bottom.
2. Descending: the em-dash row sorts to the top.
